title: ヒヤシンスSの後に・勝者の影に

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I did great in the Hyacinth Stakes! But… while I thought I could run and simp for my Umas without bothering them, the ones who lost are crying…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I can't be a spectator if I'm running, and if someone is going to win a race, that means others have to lose. It took me too long to realize this, but I have to set my resolve!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll become better to repay those Umas whose dreams were broken! I'll show them how strong I am in my next race, the NHK Mile Cup! I can't wait!
